sample_contract.question: Can a repeatable base swim retain breathing room and articulated arms without obvious resets?
beats: she eases from the opening hover into a comfortable diagonal screen-right swimming posture

perform the first complete three-second swim phrase against a gentle implied current: soft elbow-and-palm scull with a rounded torso-to-tail propulsion wave, followed by a longer glide and relaxed recovery; the broad fin follows late

perform the same full three-second phrase a second time continuously, passing through the same pose, stroke phase and speed at the join; do not reverse time, insert a hold, duplicate the rendered first cycle or reset her body
continue the natural glide and recovery beyond the second cycle so the editor has motion handles
sample_contract.end: Roshan continues the easy screen-right-facing cruise with uninterrupted recovery motion.
sample_contract.path: in-place against an implied current for extraction, stable average pelvis location and camera; local body wave and articulated arms must still read as swimming
sample_contract.loop_note: Ask the generator to perform both cycles, not an editor to repeat the same video. Exact seams are a measured selection result, never guaranteed by prompt.
